Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import json
def f(t):
    H=len(t);W=len(t[0]); o=[r[:] for r in t]
    bg=t[0][0]; 
    # find rectangle cells: most common nonzero value forming rect
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in t for x in r if x!=bg)
    rectv=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows=[r for r in range(H) if any(t[r][c]==rectv for c in range(W))]
    cols=[c for c in range(W) if any(t[r][c]==rectv for r in range(H))]
    r0,r1=min(rows),max(rows); c0,c1=min(cols),max(cols)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=t[r][c]
            if v==bg or v==rectv: continue
            if c<c0: o[r][c0]=v           # left marker -> left face
            elif c>c1: o[r][c1]=v         # right marker -> right face
            elif r<r0: o[r0][c]=v         # top marker -> top face
            else: o[r1][c]=v              # bottom marker -> bottom face
    return o
print(f(G['Demo pair 1 input'])==G['Demo pair 1 output'])
print(json.dumps(f(G['Test input'])))
